annotation.speech2: Two parabolas through the origin showing the traces of the hyperbolic paraboloid z equals y squared over 3 minus x squared over 3. The blue parabola opens upward and is the trace along the y axis. The red parabola opens downward and is the trace along the x axis. The origin, where they meet, is the saddle point.
The blue parabola z equals y squared over 3, the trace in the plane x equals 0, which opens upward, so the function is positive along the y axis.
The red parabola z equals negative x squared over 3, the trace in the plane y equals 0, which opens downward, so the function is negative along the x axis.
The origin, where the two traces meet. The function increases in one direction and decreases in the other, so this is a saddle point.
